scope_note: Escondida: BHP 57.5% (operator), Rio Tinto 30% (equity-accounted JV in Rio's books), JECO Corp 10% (Mitsubishi / JX Nippon Mining & Metals) and JECO2 Ltd 2.5% (USA_BHP_20F_2016.htm mining-operations table 'Ownership'); whole entity enters BHP's CbCR at 100%. Upstream mine incl. concentrators, SX-EW cathode plants, concentrate pipelines, Coloso port and desalination; no smelter or refinery (concentrate sold to third-party smelters). Underlying EBIT excludes the FY2017 exceptional item 'Escondida industrial action' gross US$(546)m (tax 179, net (367); NCI share gross (232)) and the tax-only exceptional item 'Withholding tax on Chilean dividends' US$(373)m ('paid while a concessional tax rate was available') (USA_BHP_20F_2017.htm FS note 2 'Exceptional items'). Entity-level Minera Escondida Ltda (BHP NCI note, 100%): revenue 4,576, profit after taxation 516, dividends paid to NCI 507 (USA_BHP_20F_2017.htm p.F-56). Entity-level 'income tax and specific tax on mining activities paid by' the operation per CALENDAR year (BHP ECR footnote; dividend withholding not mentioned, presumably excluded): CY2016 US$247m (AUS_BHP_EconomicContributionReport_2017.htm printed p.14); CY2017 US$340m (AUS_BHP_EconomicContributionReport_2018.htm printed p.18). FY2017 P2G tax is net of refunds: ECR 2017 footnote (3) reports refunds of US$335m received in FY2017, primarily for CY2015 Escondida payments (garbled two-column HTML). P2G 'Fees' paid to Chile (mining concession fees) are not income tax and are excluded. Small non-Chile payee lines for the same project are excluded (P2G CSV, CountryCodeList GBR/USA). Group consolidated PBT US$10,322m (USA_BHP_20F_2017.htm §5.1.1 Consolidated Income Statement, 'Profit before taxation'); net income tax and royalty-related taxation paid US$(2,585)m, refunded US$501m (USA_BHP_20F_2017.htm §5.1.4 Consolidated Cash Flow Statement). | Pampa Norte = Spence + Cerro Colorado (asset-table footnote 'Includes Spence and Cerro Colorado'), both 100% subsidiaries; SX-EW plants and the Spence concentrator are part of the mines; no smelter. Cerro Colorado: sale to EMR Capital agreed 19-Jun-2018 (USA_BHP_20F_2018.htm) but terminated Dec-2018 (USA_BHP_20F_2019.htm OFR Copper text); environmental licence expired end-CY2023, transitioning to closure Dec-2023 (USA_BHP_20F_2023.htm). Entity-level 'income tax and specific tax on mining activities paid by' the operation per CALENDAR year (BHP ECR footnote; dividend withholding not mentioned, presumably excluded): CY2016 US$61m (AUS_BHP_EconomicContributionReport_2017.htm printed p.14); CY2017 US$195m (AUS_BHP_EconomicContributionReport_2018.htm printed p.18). P2G 'Fees' paid to Chile (mining concession fees) are not income tax and are excluded. Non-Chile (GBR) payee lines for Pampa Norte excluded (P2G CSV). Group consolidated PBT US$10,322m (USA_BHP_20F_2017.htm §5.1.1 Consolidated Income Statement, 'Profit before taxation'); net income tax and royalty-related taxation paid US$(2,585)m, refunded US$501m (USA_BHP_20F_2017.htm §5.1.4 Consolidated Cash Flow Statement).
